QuestInfo.name: Beldar's Grudging Approval
QuestInfo.0: You need approval from #bBeldar#k to use the Interdimensional Portal.
QuestInfo.1: If you wanna prove to Beldar that you're strong enough, you'll have to defeat #r30 Onyx Stonegars#k in the #bAnti-Magic Forest#k and get him #b15 Onyx Stonegar Magic Pebbles#k.
QuestInfo.2: You've proved your strength to Beldar and gained his approval.

0.msg: #b(You tell Beldar that Fenelle sent you.)#k\r\n

1.msg: So, I'm to test your competence. I see the old priestess still revels in wasting my time.\r\n

2.msg: Perhaps I can make use of you. I used my last #i4036153:# #bOnyx Stonegar Magic Stone#k. Go into the #bAnti-Magic Forest#k and return with 15 of them.\r\n

yes.0: This is for the good of the common people. If you want my approval, prove that you're capable of doing good.\r\n

1.0: That will do. The townsfolk need these stones, so you've actually managed to do some good here.\r\n

0.msg: You've passed my test. Unless you have some other petty request for me, you are dismissed.\r\n

1.msg: #b(Next is Cartalion. Oh, he's right there.)#k\r\n
